title: Crossed-product realization data
statement: For every field K and continuous degree-two units class x, there exist a central simple K-algebra, a nonzero matrix size, a splitting equivalence, and locally constant matrix lifts satisfying the descent and scalar-defect equations for x.

source.place: The scalar-defect construction following Lemma 03R6, Theorem 03R7, and Section 0DVG

proof.text: Forget the topology on the cycles-to-homology morphism to ModuleCat. The forgetful functor is a left adjoint and preserves its epimorphism. ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective supplies a cycle z representing x.
Apply the prescribed-cocycle realization to z and combine its witnesses and equations with the quotient-map equality.
